projects.name: SABLE
projects.title: SABLE leather accessories portfolio concept
projects.direction: FASHION / MATERIAL: a fictional leather accessories house, two or three bags/small leather goods maximum. Work with tall high-contrast fashion typography paired with compact functional labels, an oxblood/black/chalk palette, tactile close-ups, asymmetry and decisive cropping. Avoid Morrow's olive/cream Georgia register and RIFT's cobalt/heavy sans sports register. The hero should establish the object and silhouette through a strong campaign composition, rather than a generic centered headline. Product experience: color/finish variant selection, meaningful gallery/detail views, bag add/update/remove. Prices/material descriptions are clearly illustrative. Include a namespaced Shopify Liquid product/featured-collection section and editable settings in the module, using actual Shopify product/variant data and native product forms. This source is a proposal until separately validated/uploaded; do not claim a live Shopify build.

projects.name: DAYBREAK
projects.title: DAYBREAK coffee packaging and storefront concept
projects.direction: PACKAGING / EVERYDAY CHOICE: a fictional specialty coffee roastery with two or three illustrative roast products. Rounded, substantial type; confident warm orange with contrasting blue and warm paper; original bag graphics and code-native illustration accents. The category should feel lively and approachable while carefully composed, not like Morrow skincare or RIFT sports. Hero: an expressive packaging still life with a strong graphic system. Product experience: roast choice, whole-bean versus grind selection, clear illustrative pack size/price, locally working demo bag. Design a reusable label/packaging system and show its application beyond the hero. All taste/origin/roast notes are fictional concept descriptions, not research, supply chain proof or real producer relationships. One brief graphic/packaging reveal may be useful; static design must remain strong.

projects.name: ARC
projects.title: ARC sculptural lighting portfolio concept
projects.direction: OBJECT / SPACE: a fictional lighting collection with one anchor lamp plus one or two complementary objects maximum. Precise geometric typography; cool mineral/metal tones and a restrained strong accent; an architectural object gallery with clear spatial scale. Show the same designed lamp consistently in product and room/detail imagery, using reference-led image generation as needed. Hero concept is the sculptural object and how it occupies space; do not default to decorative room parallax or floating type. Product experience: finish selection with consistent generated comparison images, visible illustrative dimensions, clear gallery, working local demo bag. Light mood imagery is an art-directed concept, not photometric performance evidence. Include a namespaced Shopify Liquid section/schema that reads real catalog/variant data, with editable campaign/finish presentation and correct native form semantics; preserve inherited Morrow templates. Source proposal until validated/uploaded. Spatial skills qualify here; load only what genuinely supports the object/space decision.

projects.name: SIDE B
projects.title: SIDE B independent records portfolio concept
projects.direction: CULTURE / COLLECTION: a fictional independent record imprint with three invented releases maximum, clearly fictional titles/artists and no invented collaborations, testimonials or chart/sales claims. Design original, coherent but individually distinct cover artwork and label/sleeve graphics, then create generated physical vinyl/sleeve product photography. Typography should have an expressive poster/cultural register distinct from all other concepts; explore strong display/slab lettering with carefully controlled utilitarian captions. A bold print-inspired palette and a collection-driven layout, not a beige luxury template. Product experience: meaningful collection filtering, product detail/format choice, gallery or sleeve-detail reveal, working local demo bag. No fake 'play' control: audio only if an actual authorized asset exists and provenance is documented; otherwise omit playback. Demonstrate graphic-design depth through covers and campaign/poster application. One controlled sleeve/cover reveal can support discovery; motion is optional.
